body.statement: At \(a=q_0=e_0=e_1=1/2\), \((p_0,p_1)=(3/10,4/5)\), and \(G=B=C=2\), the sharp upper endpoint is \(F_+(P)=61/80\), the first Proposition 3 component is \(V_1^+=25/32\), the second is \(V_2^+=49/64\), and therefore \(V^+-F_+(P)=1/320>0\). The same strict ordering persists on a relative neighborhood inside \(\mathcal M_\eta\) for every \(\eta<1/5\).
body.justification: An exact rational witness certifies that compatibility has non-negligible empirical content beyond the published relaxations.
body.gap: The numerical examples in Tan (2025) do not supply this exact active-product strictness certificate.
body.consumer: It is a regression test for software implementing both the sharp and conservative binary endpoints.
